report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 总体概念与功能架构由正文中的主名称、Logo方向、三层范围、三区两翼协同回路和三节点结构展开；site-overview/key-areas 图件、provisional 几何、指标与双语提案形成交叉证据，法定红线和工程结论保持 unknown/to_verify。
taskbook_must_address_zh: 总体概念、主名称、英文名称和命名体系
视觉识别与Logo方向
三大定位、五大功能和三区两翼协同回路
总体空间结构图和区域创新协同关系
综合规划、空间产业融合与国土空间规划创新思路
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The proposal explicitly covers the name, logo direction, three levels, three zones/two wings, and three-node structure in its narrative; site-overview/key-areas figures, provisional geometry, metrics, and bilingual text cross-check the evidence, while statutory redlines and engineering conclusions remain unknown/to_verify.

report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 全栈AI与创新生态由七个公开机制案例、AI创新生态图谱的八类要素、众智园全栈自主体系、AI原点社区生态和中关村科技服务翼接口展开；案例仅作机制参照，主体、资金、算力和合作均保持 unknown/to_verify。
taskbook_must_address_zh: 5-8个全球AI创新生态案例
AI创新生态图谱
众智园全栈自主体系
AI原点社区创新生态
中关村科技服务翼支撑机制
土地、空间、产业、资金、人才、算力、数据、场景机制
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Seven public mechanism cases, an eight-element AI ecosystem map, Zhongzhiyuan’s full-stack system, the AI Origin Community ecosystem, and the Zhongguancun service-wing interface are described in the proposal; cases are mechanisms only and actors, funds, compute, and partnerships remain unknown/to_verify.

report_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: AI+场景、画像与行业测试由12张具备触发/AI角色/人工角色/空间/可达性/隐私/指标/停止条件的场景卡、6类画像和3项 proposed 协议展开；三节点和小月河公共体验路径均有空间—运营映射，真实数据与已批准运营保持 unknown/to_verify。
taskbook_must_address_zh: 不少于10张AI场景卡
不少于3个AI产业测试验证场景
不少于5类用户画像
场景-空间-运营映射
小月河场景赋能翼和公共体验路径
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Twelve cards expand trigger, AI role, human role, space, accessibility, privacy, measures, and stop conditions; six personas and three proposed protocols map scenarios to nodes and the Xiaoyuehe public-experience path, with real-data and approved-operation claims kept unknown/to_verify.

requirements.title_zh: 公共空间、新业态与地标
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 公共空间、新业态与地标由京张遗址公园AI公共空间的轻介入策略、东西缝合与南北贯通、三类可撤AI地标、荣誉展示体系和可替换组件库展开；蓝线、文保、交通、权属和工程可行性保持 to_verify/unknown。
taskbook_must_address_zh: 京张遗址公园AI公共空间
东西缝合与南北贯通概念策略
大钟寺智能原生消费与商务场景
不少于3个AI朝圣地标
荣誉展示体系和公共空间组件库
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The light-touch Jingzhang Heritage Park AI public-space strategy, east-west stitch, north-south continuity, three removable AI landmarks, honor-display ledger, and replaceable component library are stated; blue-line, heritage, traffic, title, and engineering feasibility remain to_verify/unknown.

report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 京张文化与国际叙事由铁路时间线、中关村创新方法、AI新文化问题卡、导视/标识/符号系统、纸本/语音来源卡和双语国际传播文案展开；历史事实、图像、字体、肖像和商标均设清权门槛。
taskbook_must_address_zh: 京张铁路历史文化资源系统
中关村创新文化与AI新文化叙事
空间文化系统和表达载体
导视、标识、符号系统
城市气质和国际传播叙事
requirements.evidence_summary_en: The cultural narrative links the railway timeline, Zhongguancun innovation practice, and AI-native question cards through wayfinding, signs, symbols, paper/audio source cards, and bilingual international copy; historical facts, images, fonts, portraits, and marks remain rights-gated.

report_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
requirements.evidence_summary_zh: 活动、运营与长期机制由年度活动框架、活动品牌与传播视觉、开发者社区、AI场景开放运营、公共体验/地标巡检和国际传播—需求对接六项机制展开；主体、频次、预算、审批和招商转化保持 to_verify/unknown。
taskbook_must_address_zh: 年度活动体系
活动品牌与传播视觉系统
开发者社区运营机制
AI场景开放运营机制
公共体验和城市地标运营
国际传播和招引转化机制
requirements.evidence_summary_en: Six operating mechanisms cover the annual activity framework, event identity and communication, developer community, AI-scenario opening, public-experience/landmark operations, and international communication with needs matching; actors, frequency, budget, approvals, and recruitment conversion remain to_verify/unknown.

objective_alignment.evidence_summary_zh: 以三大定位为三条工作线，把AI创新生态、公共体验和京张文化转译为可达、可试、可回退的城市接口。
objective_alignment.evidence_summary_en: The three positions become accessible, testable, and reversible city interfaces linking AI ecosystem, public experience, and Jingzhang heritage.
proposal_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景

function_match.evidence_summary_zh: 正文明确三大定位、五大功能、三区两翼、三层范围和三节点，并以“看得懂—试得起—用得到”形成协同回路。
function_match.evidence_summary_en: The proposal names the three positions, five functions, three zones/two wings, three levels, and three nodes, connected by an understand-test-use loop.
proposal_sections: 指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵

brand_identity.evidence_summary_zh: 主名称、英文名称、门框/枕木/留白Logo方向和双语传播规则均已展开；不主张商标注册，不冒用第三方标识。
brand_identity.evidence_summary_en: The name, English name, doorway/sleeper/open-gap mark direction, and bilingual communication rules are explicit; no registration or third-party identity is claimed.

regional_synergy.evidence_summary_zh: 三区两翼以资源、服务、公共体验和文化入口形成内部回路；外部区域协同只作为待核的知识/产业/社区接口，不虚构合作。
regional_synergy.evidence_summary_en: The zones and wings form an internal resource-service-experience-culture loop; external regional links remain verification interfaces, with no invented partnerships.
proposal_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究

planning_innovation.evidence_summary_zh: 以接口带、可逆组件、空间—产业—运营联动和A/B/C指标分层，提出概念性国土空间规划创新思路，同时保留法定边界。
planning_innovation.evidence_summary_en: The interface belt, reversible components, space-industry-operations link, and A/B/C metric tiers provide conceptual planning innovation while preserving statutory boundaries.
proposal_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
指标体系、面积复算与合规矩阵

industry_support.evidence_summary_zh: 八类AI生态要素、七个公开机制案例、三项行业测试协议和资源池—沙盒—反馈—审议循环构成产业支撑证据。
industry_support.evidence_summary_en: Eight AI ecosystem elements, seven public mechanism cases, three industry protocols, and the resource-sandbox-feedback-review loop provide industry support evidence.
proposal_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景

scenario_perceptibility.evidence_summary_zh: 12张场景卡均有触发、角色、空间、可达性、隐私、指标和停止条件，且映射N1—N3与小月河场景赋能翼。
scenario_perceptibility.evidence_summary_en: All 12 cards specify trigger, roles, space, accessibility, privacy, measures, and stop conditions, mapped to N1-N3 and the Xiaoyuehe wing.
proposal_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景

spatial_clarity.evidence_summary_zh: 三层范围、三区两翼、三节点、东西缝合和南北贯通均有文字与几何索引；点位和面积明确标为 provisional。
spatial_clarity.evidence_summary_en: The three levels, zones/wings, nodes, east-west stitch, and north-south continuity have narrative and geometry references; points and areas are explicitly provisional.
proposal_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

transferability.evidence_summary_zh: 组件库、三项协议、P1—P5项目清单、六项年度运营机制和退出条件可供专业团队继续深化。
transferability.evidence_summary_en: The component library, three protocols, P1-P5 project list, six annual-operation mechanisms, and exit conditions are structured for professional deepening.
proposal_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划

expression_completeness.evidence_summary_zh: 双语正文、场景/画像/协议、结构化矩阵、指标、几何和可离线交付索引共同构成表达链；视觉/缺图问题另列为越界待办。
expression_completeness.evidence_summary_en: Bilingual narrative, cards/personas/protocols, matrices, metrics, geometry, and offline delivery indexes form the expression chain; visual defects are recorded as out-of-scope follow-up.
proposal_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景

public_compliance.evidence_summary_zh: 匿名聚合、人工复核、人工回退、退出、来源清权、风险登记和 provisional/to_verify/unknown 边界均已写入正文与结构化文件。
public_compliance.evidence_summary_en: Anonymous aggregation, human review, fallback, exit, rights clearance, risk logging, and provisional/to_verify/unknown boundaries are explicit in text and structured files.

international_communication.evidence_summary_zh: 双语名称、历史—创新—AI新文化三段叙事、公开案例机制和可理解的无障碍信息形成国际传播内容；不使用未经授权的图像、字体、肖像或商标。
international_communication.evidence_summary_en: A bilingual identity, three-part heritage-innovation-AI culture narrative, public case mechanisms, and accessible plain-language information support international communication without unlicensed media or marks.
proposal_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌

long_term_operation_value.evidence_summary_zh: 年度公示、季度抽查、开发者社区、场景轮换、地标巡检、失败修复和国际需求对接形成长期资产闭环；主体与预算仍待核。
long_term_operation_value.evidence_summary_en: Annual disclosure, quarterly checks, developer community, scenario rotation, landmark inspection, failure repair, and international needs matching form a long-term asset loop; owners and budgets remain to_verify.
proposal_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
